Title 3—
The President
Executive Order 13071 of December 29, 1997
Adjustments of Certain Rates of Pay
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States of America, including the laws cited herein,
it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1. Statutory Pay Systems. The rates of basic pay or salaries of
the statutory pay systems (as defined in 5 U.S.C. 5302(1)), as adjusted
under 5 U.S.C. 5303(b), are set forth on the schedules attached hereto and
made a part hereof:
(a) The General Schedule (5 U.S.C. 5332(a)) at Schedule 1;
(b) The Foreign Service Schedule (22 U.S.C. 3963) at Schedule 2; and
(c) The schedules for the Veterans Health Administration of the Department
of Veterans Affairs (38 U.S.C. 7306, 7404; section 301(a) of Public Law
102-40) at Schedule 3.
Sec. 2. Senior Executive Service. The rates of basic pay for senior executives
in the Senior Executive Service, as adjusted under 5 U.S.C. 5382, are set
forth on Schedule 4 attached hereto and made a part hereof.
Sec. 3. Executive Salaries. The rates of basic pay or salaries for the following
offices and positions are set forth on the schedules attached hereto and
made a part hereof:
(a) The Executive Schedule (5 U.S.C. 5312-5318) at Schedule 5;
(b) The Vice President (3 U.S.C. 104) and the Congress (2 U.S.C. 31)
at Schedule 6; and
(c) Justices and judges (28 U.S.C. 5, 44(d), 135, 252, and 461(a)) at Schedule
7.
Sec. 4. Uniformed Services. Pursuant to sections 601 and 604 of Public
Law 105-85, the rates of monthly basic pay (37 U.S.C. 203(a)) for members
of the uniformed services and the rate of monthly cadet or midshipman
pay (37 U.S.C. 203(c)) are set forth on Schedule 8 attached hereto and
made a part hereof.
Sec. 5. Locality-Based Comparability Payments. (a) Pursuant to sections 5304
and 5304a of title 5, United States Code, locality-based comparability pay-
ments shall be paid in accordance with Schedule 9 attached hereto and
made a part hereof.
(b) The Director of the Office of Personnel Management shall take such
actions as may be necessary to implement these payments and to publish
appropriate notice of such payments in the Federal Register.

1996, is superseded.

research_rationale:
EO 13071 (62 FR 68521, signed 1997-12-29) is the 1998 federal pay-adjustment order. Its sections 1 to 5 state the pay schedules, section 6 their effective dates and section 7 supersedes EO 13033. The held Federal Register text of EO 13106 (signed 1998-12-07) supersedes EO 13071 in its section 7: "Executive Order 13071 of December 29, 1997, is superseded." The end is recorded as 1998-12-07 with the later schedule-effective dates disclosed. The three selected machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR and the OFR order catalog) are used only for the coverage each states; none yields an earlier ending instrument, and the dossier chain shows EO 13106 as the only ending instrument.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 13106 contains no savings clause, but it postpones its own schedules: "The other schedules contained herein are effective on the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1, 1999." and "Schedule 8 is effective on January 1, 1999." Pay already earned or paid under the 1998 schedules for pay periods before those dates therefore stands, and no continuing independent command of EO 13071 remains after the supersession.

source_notes.date_qualification: 1998-12-07 is the supersession order's signing date; the replacement schedules' effective dates (1999-01-01 and agency-variable pay periods) are a disclosed alternative reading of when the 1998 rates stopped applying.
source_notes.reason: Replacement Schedule 8 is effective 1999-01-01 and the other replacement schedules take effect at the first applicable pay period on or after 1999-01-01, so 1998 rates may have been applied until then.
